gates.name: OFFICIAL_DISCOVERY
gates.rule: Official MHCLG Planning Data brownfield evidence exists

gates.name: DIRECT_ENTITY_READBACK
gates.rule: Promotion requires direct entity readback; at most one safe retry after cache miss

gates.name: TEMPORAL_CURRENTNESS
gates.rule: Blank end and current temporal evidence, or fresh current permission evidence

gates.name: STRUCTURED_CAPACITY
gates.rule: Positive structured minimum and maximum dwelling capacity, strict mismatch checks

gates.name: SEMANTIC_CONSISTENCY
gates.rule: No completed, commenced, under-construction, lapsed, C2-only, mixed/masterplan ambiguity

gates.name: SOURCE_GEOMETRY_CAPTURE
gates.rule: Official point/polygon/council coordinate captured for eligible rows; POINT is not parcel polygon

gates.name: PROMOTION
gates.rule: Only rows passing all strict gates become eligible

operation_render_policy.direct_retry_fail: gate1 PASS; gate2 FAIL; gates3-7 CLOSED
operation_render_policy.direct_pass_quality_fail: gates1-2 PASS then first evidenced strict gate FAIL; remaining CLOSED
operation_render_policy.discovery_quality_control: gate1 PASS; gate2 SKIP when direct readback is unnecessary because official discovery already proves exclusion; first evidenced quality gate FAIL; remaining CLOSED
operation_render_policy.search_only_no_promotion: gate1 PASS; gate2 SKIP; gate7 FAIL_NO_DIRECT_PROMOTION

prohibitions: no canonical parcel assignment before canonical shard export and geometry intersection
